title: Positive derived inverse limits of explicit finite-prefix towers vanish
statement: Let $\mathcal T=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N^{\mathrm{op}},\mathrm{Ab})$ be the abelian category of towers [def-weil-inverse-system, lem-pc-tower-abelian], assume it has enough injectives [def-sp-enough-injectives], and assume $L=\varprojlim:\mathcal T\to\mathrm{Ab}$ is additive, so its right derived functors $R^q L$ are defined [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. For every tower $A$, every $s\in\mathbf N$, and every $q\ge1$, $R^qL(T_s(A))=0$, where $T_s(A)_n=\prod_{i<n+s}A_i$ with restriction transitions [lem-pc-roos-finite-prefix-construction].

proof.text: For the explicit tower B=T_s(A), every successor transition is restriction. Extend a tuple by zero to prove surjectivity, including the empty initial prefix. This is roosPrefix_transition_surjective.

Fix a surjective tower $B=(B_n,g_n)$. By [lem-pc-tower-injective-embedding], embed it as a subobject $B\hookrightarrow I$ of a tower whose level groups are injective and whose transition maps $p_n:I_{n+1}\to I_n$ are split surjections. Put $Q_n=I_n/B_n$; the induced transition $Q_{n+1}\to Q_n$ is surjective, because a representative in $I_n$ lifts along the split surjection $p_n$ and its class maps to the prescribed class. Thus $0\to B\to I\to Q\to0$ is a short exact sequence of towers [lem-pc-tower-abelian].

The tower $I$ is injective in the tower category by [lem-pc-injective-split-tower-injective]. Therefore its higher derived limits vanish directly from the injective-resolution definition [def-sp-left-exact-additive]: resolve $I$ by the identity in degree zero. Since the kernel tower $B$ has surjective transitions, [lem-weil-pbc-tower-limit-exact-surjective-kernels] (b), with $R=\mathbf Z$, makes $\varprojlim I\to\varprojlim Q$ surjective. The long exact sequence of right derived functors for $0\to B\to I\to Q\to0$, supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-horseshoe-delta-functor] (2) (its hypotheses hold: the tower category has enough injectives [lem-pc-tower-enough-injectives] and $\varprojlim$ is additive and left exact [lem-pc-tower-limit-left-exact]), then has $\varprojlim I\to\varprojlim Q\to R^1\varprojlim B\to R^1\varprojlim I=0$; hence $R^1\varprojlim B=0$.

source.place: Tag 07KW, Lemma 15.88.1 (3), right acyclicity of Mittag--Leffler systems

proof.text: For every $q\ge2$, the same long exact sequence gives an isomorphism $R^q\varprojlim B\cong R^{q-1}\varprojlim Q$, because the adjacent groups $R^q\varprojlim I$ and $R^{q-1}\varprojlim I$ vanish. The quotient tower $Q$ is again surjective by Step 1, so induction on $q$ (with the base case $q=1$ proved in Step 2, applied to every surjective tower) gives $R^{q-1}\varprojlim Q=0$, and therefore $R^q\varprojlim B=0$.
